title: Field enhanced thermally activated mechanism in a square Dy4 aggregate

material_class.structural_family: μ4-OH-centred square Dy4 with a Dy4O8 core

synthesis.procedure: A suspension of Dy(ClO4)3·6H2O (0.2 mmol, 113.8 mg) and H2hpch (0.2 mmol, 48.2 mg) in CH3OH/CH3CN (5 mL/15 mL) was treated with NaHCO3 (0.4 mmol, 33.6 mg). The ensuing orange solution was stirred for 6 h and filtered. The filtrate was left undisturbed for slow solvent evaporation. Yellow plate-shaped crystals of 1 formed after 3 days. The main text only states that H2hpch and Dy(ClO4)3·6H2O were reacted in 1:3 methanol/acetonitrile with NaHCO3 (see ESI) and crystals formed over three days.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: stirred suspension followed by filtration and slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered; filtrate left undisturbed for slow evaporation to give yellow plate-shaped single crystals after 3 days
synthesis.yield: 38 mg (25%, based on the metal salt)

properties.summary: Compound 1 is a single-molecule magnet. Under zero dc field, χMT is 56.05 cm3 K mol−1 at room temperature, falls to a minimum of 50.58 cm3 K mol−1 at 10 K, then rises slightly to 51.1 cm3 K mol−1 at 2.0 K. Two relaxation processes are observed, with high-temperature barriers of 30.3 K (slow) and 16 K (fast). Under an optimal 1 kOe field the high-frequency process is suppressed and the thermally activated barrier increases to 92 K, about three times the zero-field barrier. Field-cooled and zero-field-cooled data indicate molecular rather than long-range ordering.

measurements.name: χMT
measurements.conditions: room temperature; polycrystalline sample; SI reports the χMT curve at 1 kOe

measurements.name: Δ_HT (slow relaxation, zero field)
measurements.conditions: Hdc = 0 Oe; high-temperature regime T > 7 K; τ0 = 30 × 10−6 s

measurements.name: Δ_HT (fast relaxation, zero field)
measurements.conditions: Hdc = 0 Oe; high-temperature regime; τ0 = 37 × 10−6 s

measurements.name: Ueff / Δ_HT
measurements.conditions: Hdc = 1 kOe; Arrhenius fit between 12 and 16 K; τ0 = 0.2 × 10−6 s

measurements.name: Cole–Cole α
